method: curl with browser User-Agent 'Mozilla/5.0 ... Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36'; HEAD requests for sizes; full download of the two small zips (2.6 MB deactivation report, 6.9 MB weekly); HTTP Range request for the last 8 KB of the 1.15 GB monthly zip to read its central directory (no bulk download); two single-NPI queries to the NPPES API.

notes: Static HTML; relative hrefs to zips on same host. Served 403 to non-browser fetchers; 200 with browser UA.
Page states: 'Effective 03/03/2026 NPPES will no longer support Version 1 of the Monthly and Weekly Downloadable File.' Use V.2 only.
Filenames change every cycle; scrape this page each run for current hrefs.

monthly_full_replacement.estimated_rows: ~9.7M (11,632,650,533 bytes / 1,198 bytes-per-row observed in weekly file)
monthly_full_replacement.readme_quote_scope: 'These files will contain all of the FOIA-disclosable ACTIVE provider data in NPPES' (Readme v.2 dated May 12, 2026, sec 1.2) - deactivated NPIs are NOT in the monthly full file.

monthly_deactivation_report.title_row: NPPES Deactivated Records as of Aug 10 2026
monthly_deactivation_report.notes: Cumulative list of currently-deactivated NPIs as of the report date. No deactivation reason: readme states 'NPI Deactivation Reason Code ... This is not publicly disseminated' - the 330-column layout reserves the column but it is always blank in public files.

weekly_incremental.notes: Weekly file contains only records new/changed since last file. NPIs deactivated during the week appear as stub rows with ONLY 'NPI' and 'NPI Deactivation Date' populated (verified empirically; even reason code blank). Readme sec 1.3.
